baseline_invariants.rule: Keep baseline parameters and protected agent profiles unchanged; implement only the mechanism and explicitly authorized topology extensions.

mechanism_summaries.name: Investor costly punishment opportunity after trustee return
mechanism_summaries.summary: T1 adds a Trustor punishment action after Trustee return; each punishment coin costs the Trustor 1 and reduces Trustee payoff by 5.

required_code_changes.description: Add treatment configuration without replacing baseline game parameters.
acceptance_criteria: B and T1 are selectable treatments.
T2 and T3 cannot alter actions or payoffs.
Baseline constants remain unchanged.

required_code_changes.description: Store treatment and punishment settings on the environment.
acceptance_criteria: Environment exposes current treatment state.
Fallback cap is documented as a transfer assumption.

required_code_changes.description: Pass separate public treatment context into native Trustor and Trustee prompts.

details.protected_profile_rule: Do not change role_profile text, profile constructor binding, or stored _profile.

acceptance_criteria: Trustor and Trustee native decisions can receive T1 context.
Protected profile strings remain byte-for-byte unchanged.

required_code_changes.description: Append non-profile T1 public punishment context to the Trustor transfer prompt.

details.context_text: In PT, after the Trustee return, the Trustor may spend punishment; each coin spent reduces Trustee payoff by 5; include configured cap rule.

acceptance_criteria: Trustor sees punishment availability before transfer in T1.
No punishment text appears in B.

required_code_changes.description: Append non-profile T1 public punishment context to the Trustee return prompt.

details.context_text: In PT, after the Trustee return, the Trustor may spend punishment; each coin spent reduces Trustee payoff by 5; include configured cap rule.

acceptance_criteria: Trustee sees punishment availability before return in T1.
No protected Trustee profile text is edited.

required_code_changes.description: Add a distinct post-return Trustor punishment decision method.

details.validation: 0 to configured cap or fallback cap

acceptance_criteria: Punishment is not merged with transfer or return.
Invalid punishment amounts are clipped or rejected consistently.

required_code_changes.description: Insert the T1 punishment stage after Trustee return and after base payoff calculation.

details.context_path: Pass T1 public context into both native act calls.

acceptance_criteria: Trustor transfer occurs before Trustee return.
Punishment occurs only after Trustee return.
Base payoff formulas are preserved before adjustment.

required_code_changes.description: Display prior punishment fields when present without changing topology.
acceptance_criteria: History remains valid for B records.
Punishment history is visible for T1 records.

required_code_changes.description: Add treatment-separated cooperation and punishment metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Metrics separate B from T1.
Punishment use is logged independently of transfer and return.

new_metrics.name: behavioral_trust_by_treatment
new_metrics.definition: Mean Trustor sent amount or positive-send rate by B versus T1.

new_metrics.name: actual_trustworthiness_by_treatment
new_metrics.definition: Mean Trustee returned amount and return rate by B versus T1.

new_metrics.name: punishment_behavior_by_treatment
new_metrics.definition: Mean and frequency of punishment amount in T1.

new_metrics.name: payoff_effects_by_treatment
new_metrics.definition: Base and final payoffs separated by treatment.

validation_requirements: Verify protected profile assignments and constructor profile binding are unchanged.
Verify baseline constants and NUM_GAMES are unchanged.
Verify dyadic random matching is unchanged.
Verify T1 context is shown to Trustor before transfer and Trustee before return.
Verify punishment is a post-return Trustor response stage.
Verify base payoff formulas are computed before punishment adjustment.
Verify only B and T1 are executable treatments.
tests_or_checks: Run B with punishment disabled and compare native action/payoff fields to baseline.
Run T1 and confirm stage order transfer-return-punishment.
Test configured punishment cap and fallback cap.
Test punishment p reduces Trustor payoff by p and Trustee payoff by 5p.
Test logs contain treatment, actions, base payoffs, punishment, and final payoffs.
AST or text check protected profile snippets remain unchanged.
risks: Punishment grid is not paper-specified and uses a documented configurable cap.
Replacing broad methods may accidentally alter baseline invariants.
Negative final payoffs may occur if not bounded by the chosen cap rule.
out_of_scope: Do not implement paper rounds, endowments, sample size, fixed roles, or random-payoff selection.
Do not implement strategy-method conditional schedules.
Do not implement personality-factor profiles or belief elicitation.
Do not implement T2 or T3 robustness games without additional rules.
Do not add network topology or partner-specific network knowledge.
Replacing baseline population, rounds, payoff constants, repeat count, or unapproved topology with paper settings.
